# oxedi

> oxedi is a lossless, fast parser and writer for X12 EDI 835 healthcare remittance files, for Python and DuckDB. Every input byte is kept, and problems come back as diagnostics instead of errors.

Read an 835 into payment, claim, service line and adjustment tables for Polars, pandas, pyarrow or DuckDB, validate it, and write an 835 back from tables. Install with `pip install oxedi`. The browser viewer reads files locally and never uploads them.

## Get started

- [Get started](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/start/): What oxedi is and where to begin
- [Install](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/start/install/): Install the Python package
- [The 835 in five minutes](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/start/the-835/): What an 835 remittance contains and how oxedi models it
- [Try it in your browser](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/start/viewer/): Read an 835 in the browser viewer without installing anything

## Python

- [Reading 835 files](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/reading/): Parse files into payment, claim, service line and adjustment tables
- [Reading large files](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/large-files/): Stream tables one transaction or claim at a time, and parse many files in parallel
- [Diagnostics](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/diagnostics/): The problems oxedi reports instead of raising errors
- [Writing 835 files](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/writing/): Write an 835 from tables with checked control numbers, counts and balancing
- [Writing from your own tables](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/own-tables/): Build an 835 from your own DataFrames
- [When the writer refuses a file](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/when-write-refuses/): Why the writer rejects input and how to fix it
- [Sharing data without patient information](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/without-patient-data/): Mask patient names, ids and dates in the tables and diagnostics with a key
- [Validating with pyx12](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/python/pyx12/): Run pyx12 validation and get findings as oxedi diagnostics
- [Customizing the spec](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/customize/spec/): Adapt parsing to your payers by changing the spec, which is plain data

## DuckDB

- [DuckDB extension](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/duckdb/): Overview of the DuckDB extension
- [Reading with SQL](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/duckdb/reading/): read_835 over files, folders, globs and cloud storage
- [Writing with COPY](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/duckdb/writing/): Write an 835 with COPY
- [Types and limits](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/duckdb/limits/): Column types and known limits of the extension

## Recipes

- [A Parquet lakehouse with DuckDB](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/recipes/lakehouse/): Turn remittances into a Parquet lakehouse
- [Analytics with Polars](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/recipes/polars/): Analyze payments and denials with Polars
- [oxedi in a pipeline](https://javillegas.dev/oxedi/latest/recipes/pipelines/): Use oxedi in batch and scheduled pipelines
